Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made an error in the first step by misinterpreting the film title "And The Winter Ends" and instead retrieved information about the unrelated film "Captain America: The Winter Soldier." This misdirection set the subsequent steps on an incorrect path, leading to repeated searches that failed to identify the correct film or its director. Proper identification of the film title at the beginning could have led to more accurate searches and potentially finding the correct information.
